energy_inventory.hazard: Train can roll, separate or shift even with0%target; suspension/body/lift loads can fall.
energy_inventory.required_task_definition: Accepted independent rail-vehicle restraint, track protection and engineered lift/support points; task-specific stability.
energy_inventory.prohibition: Brake command or estimated grade is not independent blocking.

energy_inventory.hazard: Combination chamber spring remains hazardous without air.
energy_inventory.required_task_definition: Exact delivered OEM qualified service/replacement and independently restrained rescue method if required.
energy_inventory.prohibition: Do not open spring chamber or infer safe force from zero gauge pressure.

energy_inventory.hazard: Check valves/closed cocks can trap pressure or allow reaccumulation.
energy_inventory.required_task_definition: Actual tagged circuit/isolation/verification and pressure-vessel/brake protection basis.
energy_inventory.prohibition: No universal drain/vent sequence or assumed single-gauge isolation.

energy_inventory.hazard: Loaded coils, bump stops, sidebearers, stairs/lifts and body supports can store force or move.
energy_inventory.required_task_definition: Actual unloading/restraint/support method for selected geometry and task.
energy_inventory.prohibition: Do not remove a mount, guide, torque link or stop under uncharacterized load.

energy_inventory.hazard: Multiple sources, charger/generator backfeed and stored electrical energy.
energy_inventory.required_task_definition: Electrical specialist establishes disconnect/absence-of-energy, discharge, grounding/bonding and test precautions.
energy_inventory.prohibition: Software off, disconnected low-voltage control or E-stop is not all-source isolation.

energy_inventory.energy: Diesel start, fuel and hot exhaust
energy_inventory.hazard: Unexpected start, fuel/fire/chemical exposure, hot cooling/exhaust/DPF.
energy_inventory.required_task_definition: Exact engine shutdown/start isolation/cooldown/fuel/fire and exhaust service methods.
energy_inventory.prohibition: No homemade fuel/exhaust/DPF bypass or occupied-cabin exposure assumption.

energy_inventory.energy: Hydrostatic propulsion pressure and rotating drive
energy_inventory.hazard: Closed-loop/charge pressure, accumulator if actually fitted, inertia and mechanically coupled axles.
energy_inventory.required_task_definition: Actual OEM drive circuit and supported shaft/gear energy isolation; restrained rotating hardware.
energy_inventory.prohibition: Hydraulic propulsion is not the superseded hydraulic coach-brake system.

energy_inventory.hazard: Ballast, actuators, restrained springs/pressure and lifted equipment store energy.
energy_inventory.required_task_definition: Approved guarded fixture/load path/containment, calibrated instruments, abort/rescue plan and qualified director.
energy_inventory.prohibition: No test from a crosswalk or blank result sheet alone.

default_defect_rule: Unassessed safety-related condition is out of service pending qualified disposition; no provisional degraded passenger mode.
no_dispatch_conditions: Any wheel/axle/bearing/suspension/pivot/retention or track defect outside accepted criteria, or unknown safety significance
Crack, missing/loose retention, disturbed hub/wheel/axle joint, carrier/guide reaction damage or uncertain load path
Brake service/release/parking response, chamber stroke, air reserve/leak/timing or indication disagreement outside accepted criteria
Any mechanically caged/disabled brake, unknown isolated trainline or unapproved connector/cock configuration
Unsecured door/gate/stair/lift/bridge or unqualified accessible/egress solution
Missing route protection/communication/qualified staffing or unauthorized reversing/pushing/two-train mode
Fuel/exhaust/fire/electrical/structural hazard, emergency lighting/egress defect, or weather/track condition not accepted for operation
